blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Fifty eight members of the international gang True Brown Style (TBS) were among the 200 individuals arrested during the September 21 protests in Mendiola, Manila, according to Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla. “Tinignan namin ‘yung investigation namin, out of the 200 we arrested last September 21 doon sa Mendiola, 58 were members of True Brown Style. So nakikita yung propensity for violence nila,” Remulla told reporters on Tuesday. (We looked at our investigations, out of the 200 we arrested last September 21 in Mendiola, 58 were members of True Brown Style. So we see their propensity for violence.) […]...
